data.summary: This directory represents a data partition dated 2026-01-30 containing CSV datasets for customers, orders, order items, and products, along with a success marker file. These files form a snapshot of transactional and master data for downstream analytics or data warehousing.

file_insights.name: _SUCCESS
file_insights.summary: Empty success indicator file for the partition.
file_insights.detailed_description: Indicates the successful completion or generation of the data partition in this directory.

file_insights.name: customers.csv
file_insights.source_summary: CSV containing customer records with fields customer_id, name, city, membership_tier, changed_at, event_id, is_deleted.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains customer record changes partitioned by date, tracking updates and soft deletes.

file_insights.name: order_items.csv
file_insights.source_summary: CSV file with order item data including order_item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, changed_at, event_id, is_deleted.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains order item details for orders processed on this date, including pricing and product relations.

file_insights.name: orders.csv
file_insights.source_summary: CSV file containing orders with fields order_id, customer_id, order_status, ordered_at, changed_at, event_id, is_deleted.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains order header information, tracking status and timestamps for customer orders.

file_insights.name: products.csv
file_insights.source_summary: CSV file containing product details including product_id, name, category, price, changed_at, event_id, is_deleted.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains product catalog entries and category details updated or created on this partition date.
